remarks: This is a rare opportunity to build the home of your dreams on Long Neck Point - one of the most sought after and picturesque communities on the Eastern Seaboard! As part of a 4 unit subdivision, you will have shared use of two boat docks and Long Island Sound access! Your newly constructed home will enjoy amazing views to Gorham's Pond and Long Island Sound. Walk or bike to Pear Tree Point or Darien's newest Great Island Park. Perfectly proximate to town, beaches, shopping, dining and schools. Darien residents enjoy terrific parks, nature center, two unique beaches, paddle tennis, senior activities and additional amazing amenities; many dog friendly as well! Bring your architect and start planning!
